description: Report a dagon_buy_credits payment you signed yourself so the configured account is credited (POST /v1/credits/purchase/confirm). Fee sponsored: pass signed_transaction, the base64 wallet-signed transaction, without submitting it (the payment service adds the fee payer's signature and submits it; resending the same one is safe). Not fee sponsored: submit it yourself and pass its signature.

signature.description: Base58 Solana transaction signature of the payment you submitted (not fee sponsored).

signed_transaction.description: Base64 wallet-signed transaction of a fee-sponsored purchase, not submitted.

name: dagon_confirm_purchase
title: Confirm a Dagon credit purchase
